title: Instruction on the query side only
goal:
Build the model inputs of Section 3.2 and Equation 1. Write three functions:

- `format_query(task, query)` returns the string `"Instruct: {task}\nQuery: {query}"`, with a real newline character between the two lines.
- `build_inputs(task, queries, docs)` returns `(query_texts, doc_texts)`. Every query gets the instruction. Documents don't, so the document index can be built once and reused for any task. Return new lists and leave the inputs unchanged.
- `add_eos(token_ids, eos_id)` returns a new list that is `token_ids` with `eos_id` appended. It must not modify `token_ids`. The pooled vector in Exercise 1 is read at this token.
hints: Documents keep their text exactly, so `doc_texts` is `list(docs)`.
`token_ids + [eos_id]` builds a new list. `token_ids.append(eos_id)` changes the caller's list.
